concern_results.conclusion: The split is implemented as specified: base_derived_candidate holds the one base-derived computation shared by both freeze paths, the receipt records packet_sha256 and candidate_sha256 separately, candidate_paths derive from the candidate, and every in-chain comparison (succession, contiguous-chain, completion checkpoint, dispositions manifest, composite base) was retargeted from packet to candidate, including the loop-local rename that keeps material_candidate_change comparing the current candidate rather than a shadowed prior.

Verbatim contiguous containment plus the empty-candidate refusal preserves the nothing-lands-unread property with no false accept; the accept set widens only by packets provably containing the whole candidate; --paths without --base and wording-only proof over an assembled packet are refused; base-ref option injection is still stopped by rev-parse --verify; diff-file-alone semantics are unchanged.

Refusals cover paths-without-base, empty base-derived candidate, truncated/dropped candidate, interleaved context, unrelated packet, and the wording-proof combination, each failing closed with a message naming the corrective action; no new partial-failure, concurrency, or recovery surface is introduced and the shared deadline bounds the added git work.

The new gate case asserts each acceptance row including the paired append-passes/interleave-fails fixtures and truncation; the cross-side binder case freezes a widened packet through the controller and requires the recorded identity to equal the gate's recomputation using candidate_scope-derived base and paths; the two discriminating mutations red exactly the owning cases and the non-discriminating binder mutation is recorded as an honest negative.

With no --diff-file both hashes keep today's byte-identical value, --diff-file alone keeps today's meaning, the receipt schema gains no field, the binder's freeze_packet call is a no-op for its invocation shape, and the extraction shares one implementation rather than adding speculative abstraction.

npm bumped to 0.16.0 in package.json and both lockfile sites; receipts written before this change keep their meaning since their packet and candidate were equal by construction; nothing migrates and reverting restores prior behavior without invalidating any receipt.

Receipts now record the two hashes separately so an auditor can see which round read which packet against one candidate; refusal messages state what to do (append rather than interleave, do not drop candidate parts); --print-candidate is documented as the identity authority so authors read rather than reconstruct it.

This merge-readiness gate cannot accept unreviewed content under the change: containment is a strict superset requirement over the prior equality for what the reviewer must have seen, the wording-only machine proof is kept off author-assembled packets, and the relaxations (succession, checkpoint, dispositions comparing candidate-to-candidate instead of packet-to-packet) drop only the assumption being removed and are stated openly rather than hidden.
